{"filename":"Approval_Note_P-204.docx","title":"Approval Note","sections":[{"heading":"Subject","body":"Equipment tag P-204 (Crude Charge Pump B) – Vibration exceeds Zone D limit, corrective action required"},{"heading":"Observation","body":"Key measurements from inspection report CM/CDU/2026/0847 dated 12 September 2026:

| Measurement Point | Horizontal (mm/s) | Vertical (mm/s) | Axial (mm/s) |
|-------------------|-------------------|-----------------|--------------|
| Pump drive end    | 8.2               | 7.4             | 3.1          |
| Pump non-drive end| 6.9               | 6.1             | 2.8          |
| Motor drive end   | 4.4               | 3.9             | 2.2          |
| Motor non-drive end| 3.8              | 3.5             | 1.9          |

Additional observations:
- Pump drive end bearing housing temperature: 79 °C (baseline 61 °C)
- Pump non-drive end bearing housing temperature: 74 °C (baseline 61 °C)
- Mechanical seal leakage: 3 drops per minute (API Plan 11, flush line clear)
- Oil level: within marks; oil condition: slight darkening, no water or metal visible"},{"heading":"Applicable criteria","body":"Per SOP-4 (Maintenance_SOP_v7.md) clause 4.2 for Group 1 machines (rated >15 kW, rigid foundation):

| Zone | Range (mm/s RMS) | Condition | Required action |
|------|------------------|-----------|-----------------|
| A    | up to 2.8        | Newly commissioned | None |
| B    | 2.8 to 4.5       | Acceptable for long-term operation | Routine monitoring |
| C    | 4.5 to 7.1       | Unsatisfactory for continuous operation | Plan corrective action; increase monitoring to weekly |
| D    | above 7.1        | Damage may occur | Restrict operation; corrective action before next run window |

(Source: Maintenance_SOP_v7.md#7)"},{"heading":"Deviation","body":"Observed drive‑end horizontal vibration: 8.2 mm/s RMS.
Zone D upper limit: 7.1 mm/s RMS.
Deviation = 8.2 – 7.1 = 1.1 mm/s RMS above the limit.
(Calculated using calculate tool: 8.2 - 7.1 = 1.0999999999999996 ≈ 1.1 mm/s)

Vertical vibration at drive end: 7.4 mm/s exceeds limit by 0.3 mm/s."},{"heading":"Recommendation","body":"1. Shut down P‑204 immediately for bearing inspection.
2. Replace bearings if wear or damage is found.
3. Perform corrective action before the next run window.
Target completion: 19 September 2026 (within 7 days of observation)."},{"heading":"Approval routing","body":"Per SOP‑4 clause 7.2 (Maintenance_SOP_v7.md#14): Zone D findings, or any recommendation requiring a unit shutdown, require endorsement by both the Section Head and the Head of Maintenance.

Required sign‑offs:
- Section Head, Rotating Equipment
- Head of Maintenance"}]}
